notes: Inner copper 0.5 oz not offered -> 1 oz. Track/space 0.15/0.10 mm -> '4/4mil': PCBWay's capabilities page treats 4 mil as 0.1 mm (https://www.pcbway.com/capabilities.html). Choosing 3/3mil would cost $308.85 with an 8-9 day build. BGA/QFP count entered as 0, like the other runs (the QFN-60 and RM2 module are counted as SMD parts). Assembly: 71 parts x qty gives a formula price below the $88 minimum (max($88, $25.27 + $0.1523 x 71 x qty)), so normal = $88 for 1 and 5 boards. $29 promo applies at both quantities: 71 parts/board, 355 parts for 5, 36 unique, 0 THT joints. The struck-through 'list' price next to $29 ($236.33 at qty 1, $239.88 at qty 5) is the qty >= 11 formula and is not charged at these quantities.
